title: PAR and ePAR wavelength intervals
author: THC Educational Content Production
alt: Wavelength axis from 350 to 800 nanometres. Conventional PAR spans 400 to 700 nanometres; extended ePAR spans 400 to 750 nanometres, adding the 700 to 750 nanometre far-red interval.
caption: PAR (400–700 nm) and ePAR (400–750 nm) are distinct photon-counting intervals. Boundaries are measurement conventions; this is not a measured lamp spectrum.
